definitions.explanation: A small, affordable paperback book format standard in Japanese publishing. Bunko editions are typically A6 size (105×148mm) and are how most novels and classic literature are republished for wide distribution.
A curated collection of books or literary works, or a small library. Often used in the names of publishing imprints or special collections.

examples.japanese: この{小説|しょうせつ}は{文庫|ぶんこ}で{読|よ}んだ。
examples.english: I read this novel in paperback.

examples.japanese: {文庫本|ぶんこぼん}はかばんに{入|い}れやすい。
examples.english: Paperback books are easy to put in a bag.

examples.japanese: {単行本|たんこうぼん}が{出|で}てから{半年|はんとし}で{文庫|ぶんこ}になった。
examples.english: It came out in paperback half a year after the hardcover was released.

examples.japanese: {学校|がっこう}の{文庫|ぶんこ}で{本|ほん}を{借|か}りた。
examples.english: I borrowed a book from the school library.

examples.japanese: {青空文庫|あおぞらぶんこ}には{著作権|ちょさくけん}の{切|き}れた{作品|さくひん}が{集|あつ}められている。
examples.english: Aozora Bunko collects works whose copyright has expired.

examples.japanese: あの{出版社|しゅっぱんしゃ}の{文庫|ぶんこ}レーベルはカバーのデザインが{美|うつく}しい。
examples.english: That publisher's paperback imprint has beautiful cover designs.

notes:
In modern usage, {文庫|ぶんこ} most commonly refers to the small paperback format ({文庫本|ぶんこぼん}). Major publishers each have their own bunko imprints: {岩波文庫|いわなみぶんこ}, {新潮文庫|しんちょうぶんこ}, {角川文庫|かどかわぶんこ}, etc.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {文庫本|ぶんこぼん} — paperback book
- {文庫|ぶんこ}サイズ — paperback size (A6)
- {文庫化|ぶんこか} — release in paperback format
- {文庫|ぶんこ}で{出|で}る — to come out in paperback

RELATED WORDS:
- {単行本|たんこうぼん} — hardcover book
- {新書|しんしょ} — new book format (slightly taller than bunko)
- {蔵書|ぞうしょ} — book collection
